qualification: Visual interpolation eligibility only. Fixed prospective policy; replay of previously captured outputs is retrospective. No force integration or accuracy claim.
rationale: Nominal-plane geometry error is limited to 10 ppm of diameter. Tighter 1 ppm and 5 ppm subsets must preserve at least 99% external grid coverage, with RMS change at most 1% and peak change at most 5% of the baseline external field span. These are display stability limits, not physical error bounds.
